ceu: ✦ The trine between the Moon and Mercury at {H:1816251347000}

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Help someone quietly, without them knowing it was you.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, your career and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, money and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Think of a way to make one of your talents pay off.

t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Start something new today, however small.
